messages:
sam_sales: Heads-up: VertexCorp procurement will only accept PO line items that include their internal charge codes (CC-1001 / CC-2002). Their PO will reference "Vertex-LLM-Base" not our marketplace sku. They still want the commit discount to apply immediately for the week-long POC.
nora_dealdesk: Noted. If PO doesn't contain our offer_id+sku, automated marketplace attribution will fail. Two routes: Private Offer with mapped SKUs, or accept PO and do a manual attribution + retro credit if metering misses.
isabel_finance: Finance preference: Private Offer for audit trail. If customer timeline forces it, we can approve a one-off manual attribution but need: signed buyer acknowledgement, credit cap, GL codes, and a 45-day claim window. Accounting requires the ack before issuing credits.
tom_se: Tech note: Some marketplaces let you include an "order detail" field that we can match on. If procurement can include our offer id in the PO description (e.g., "offer_aws_vtx_07") that could preserve automation. Can procurement do that?
sam_sales: They said their template is locked but they can put text in the line description. I'll ask them to include the offer id in the description and confirm.
ops-bot: FYI: Private Offer creation requires partner enablement + legal review. Typical ETA 48-72h after deal desk approval. See internal runbook: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/private-offer (access required).
nora_dealdesk: Draft fallback clause for manual attribution: "Redwood will accept the PO referencing the customer's internal SKU label and will manually attribute usage to the agreed marketplace SKU for the period Jul 2026. If marketplace metering does not map charges, Redwood will issue a one-time credit up to $12,500 within 45 days following invoice, subject to receipt of a signed buyer acknowledgement and audit rights." Send to legal/finance.
isabel_finance: GL codes: REV_MARKET_VTX and CREDIT_RETRO_VTX. Finance OK with $12.5k cap for a POC. Accounting will not process any credit without the signed ack attached.
tom_se: If they include the offer id in line description we can likely avoid manual stuff. Sample description to ask them to use: "Redwood offer_aws_vtx_07 | Vertex-LLM-Base". That keeps both internal label and marketplace metadata.
sam_sales: Customer replied — they can add the offer id to line description. Procurement says their AP exports the line description into their GL so this should work. They still prefer an explicit written guarantee on the commit.
nora_dealdesk: Good. If the offer id appears in line description that should maintain automation for AWS. Still need fallback language (manual credit) in case provider feed doesn't capture it. I'll queue the draft to legal.
isabel_finance: Finance: confirm we only need the signed ack if we end up crediting. If automation works, no action needed. Accounting will monitor first invoice and flag unrecognized lines.
ops-bot: Reminder: provider metadata capture varies. Azure and GCP often strip description metadata. If customer uses multi-cloud later we should consider Private Offer path.
nora_dealdesk: Legal replied and approved the one-time exception clause with edits: require signed buyer ack, cap $12.5k, 45-day claim window, Redwood audit right. Updated language posted to thread.
sam_sales: Customer signed the acknowledgement and updated the PO line descriptions to include "offer_aws_vtx_07". I uploaded PO + ack to SFDC. They requested we start the POC today.
isabel_finance: Finance confirms accounting ticket open with GL codes and will watch the invoice. If marketplace metering picks up offer id — perfect. If not, we'll run the retro credit workflow per the clause.
tom_se: I'll monitor the marketplace invoice feed and post when first invoice lands. If description got stripped we'll trigger manual reconciliation.
nora_dealdesk: Deal desk approves one-time acceptance with the agreed fallback. Action items: 1) sam_sales attach PO + ack in SFDC (done), 2) tom_se monitor invoice, 3) isabel_finance prepare accounting ticket and GL allocation. Logging exception in deal notes.
sam_sales: Thanks team — POC live. Ping here for any invoice mismatches. :rocket:
